name: Claude
description: 源自 rico-md 的「Claude」主题（MIT, ricocc/rico-md）。

root.html: <section style="max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px 16px 56px 16px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.7; color: {{text}}; background-color: #fff; word-wrap: break-word; letter-spacing: -0.01em">{{content}}</section>

title.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 24px; font-weight: 600; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.15; margin: 32px 0 24px; letter-spacing: -0.025em; background: linear-gradient(135deg, {{heading}} 0%, #e97d5b 50%, #CC8B7A 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; color: {{heading}}; line-height: 1.25; margin: 40px 0 20px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; background: linear-gradient(135deg, {{heading}} 0%, #9DC88D 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading3.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: {{text}}; line-height: 1.3; margin: 36px 0 18px; letter-spacing: -0.015em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

heading4.html: <{{tag}} style="font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #2a2a2a; line-height: 1.4; margin: 28px 0 14px; letter-spacing: -0.01em">{{content}}</{{tag}}>

strong.html: {{content}}

inlineCode.html: {{content}}

code.html: {{content}}

quote.html: {{content}}

link.html: {{content}}

tableHead.html: <th style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(193, 95, 60, 0.08) 0%, rgba(157, 200, 141, 0.08) 100%); padding: 16px 20px; text-align: left; border: none; font-weight: 600; color: {{text}}; border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(193, 95, 60, 0.2)">{{content}}</th>

tableCell.html: {{content}}

table.html: {{thead}}{{tbody}}

divider.html: <hr style="margin: 64px auto; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, rgba(193, 95, 60, 0.3), rgba(157, 200, 141, 0.3), transparent); max-width: 240px">
